[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/6074/images/8/8-1779008584-28891273.gif[/img][/center]

[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Adds a vanilla-friendly save and load preset feature to the character creation menu.
Saves up-to-20 of your favorite presets, which are located in the mod folder under "presets".

[list]
[*]Includes support for Multiplayer and Gamepad.[/*]
[*]Save up to 20 of your preferred presets.[/*]
[*]Disables main features if conflicting mods are present.[/*]
[*]Works across multiple game-supported languages.[/*]
[/list][size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b][size=4]FREQUENTLY ANTICIPATED QUESTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[quote][b]Q. [/b]Why isn't the mod loading?
[b]A. [/b]Check your SMAPI logs. If you have Default Farmer installed, this mod's features will be disabled. You cannot use both simultaneously, so please remove it from your load order.[/quote]
[quote][b]Q. [/b]When I scroll during the load menu, I hear sounds in the background. What's happening?
[b]A. [/b]You likely have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46200]Scroll Through Options In Character Menu[/url] installed and are scrolling through the options hidden behind this menu. This will not cause any issues, but if it bothers you, go into GMCM and enable the compatibility setting for this interaction.[/quote]
[quote]Q. Does this work in languages such as Chinese and Japanese?
A. Yes, this mod tries to support all languages provided by the game. If you encounter any display issues, please leave a comment so I can address this.[/quote]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b][size=4]SHOUT-OUTS TO[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12421]tylergibbs2[/url] for permission to borrow code from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12421]Default Farmer[/url].
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/fantasyandmana]sothis[/url] for assisting with the creation of the save and load icon.
